name: Love Class
description: In a college class where students are paired up and sent on dates, a sophomore is partnered with an upperclassman whose gentle kindness steals his heart.

videos.title: Let’s Begin
videos.overview: Jiwoo signs up for the "Marriage and Family" class, where students are paired in male-female duos. However, due to the surplus of male students, he is partnered with Roa, an older male student. Assigned a dating task, the two head to a vending machine to spend their budget wisely—when suddenly, Yuna appears…

videos.title: Can't Leave Her Alone
videos.overview: Yuna, traumatized by a stalker, develops a fear of men. Jiwoo volunteers to walk her home daily, despite Roa's advice to let the police handle it. Jiwoo insists on helping, but on his way home, he's attacked. Roa grows concerned when Jiwoo becomes unreachable…

videos.title: Right-Hand Man
videos.overview: Roa breaks his arm protecting Jiwoo and demands Jiwoo become his "right hand." At Roa’s home, Jiwoo ends up washing dishes and even Roa’s hair. Meanwhile, Roa’s housemate Namjoon, who secretly has feelings for Roa, calls Jiwoo out…

videos.title: Rumors
videos.overview: Rumors spread that Jiwoo and Roa are dating after a mysterious post appears on the school forum. Overwhelmed, Jiwoo avoids campus. Yuna asks Roa about Jiwoo, but he accuses her of being selfish. Meanwhile, Roa visits Jiwoo’s house in the rain…

videos.title: The Confession
videos.overview: Roa, suspecting someone they know posted the rumor, begins investigating with Yuna’s help. They find the culprit and peace returns. Then, Yuna privately confesses to Jiwoo that she has feelings for him…

videos.title: Goodbye, My Love
videos.overview: Jiwoo tells Roa about Yuna’s confession. Unexpectedly, Roa congratulates him. Jiwoo confesses his own feelings to Roa, who apologizes for misleading him and disappears. Unable to forget Roa, Jiwoo turns to Namjoon to find his whereabouts…

videos.title: Chasing That Person
videos.overview: Hyun has been searching for Kim An since enrolling in university, though they’re at the same school, he can't find him. Meanwhile, Minwoo begins avoiding his childhood friend Mal. One day, An finally visits assistant lecturer Sungmin to request a locker…

videos.title: Unspeakable Truths
videos.overview: Hyun sneaks into An’s “Marriage and Family” class. Expecting a happy reunion, he’s surprised when An acts cold and pushes him away. Meanwhile, Mal spends time at the café where Minwoo works, unaware of what’s troubling his friend.

videos.title: One-Sided Feelings
videos.overview: To help Minwoo, Mal harasses the café manager who bullies him. Meanwhile, Hyun asks Sungmin about An’s past. Seeing them talk, Ju-hyuk—who likes Sungmin—makes a move…

videos.title: Shared Time
videos.overview: Minwoo tells Hyun that Mal moved in with him. Ju-hyuk tries to get Sungmin’s attention by bringing up embarrassing stories. Hyun, meanwhile, partners with An for a shared hobby assignment.

videos.title: Just Friends?
videos.overview: The next assignment is to introduce a friend. An claims he has none, but becomes tense when Hyun says he met one. Hyun invites him to lunch, but their closeness draws stares in the cafeteria.

videos.title: Disappointment
videos.overview: While Hyun introduces Minwoo and Mal to An, Minwoo’s girlfriend, Sara, shows up. Mal gets upset and lashes out at Minwoo. Just then, Lee Si-woo appears and declares he has a deep relationship with An…

videos.title: Mixed Feelings
videos.overview: An misses class, worrying Hyun. Mal visits Hyun for advice about Minwoo. Hyun tells him to think deeply, prompting Mal to comically try all the internet’s “thinking methods.” Meanwhile, Ju-hyuk enjoys flirting with Sungmin.

videos.title: Next Step
videos.overview: An ends things with Si-woo and leaves the building looking dejected. Hyun walks him home and helps clean his ransacked room. Sungmin, meanwhile, finds something shocking while searching behind the building…

videos.title: Forms of Love
videos.overview: An wakes up in Hyun’s room and hugs him from behind while Hyun prepares breakfast. Mal and Minwoo enjoy a peaceful lunch in the park. But Sungmin is distressed, unsure of Ju-hyuk’s true feelings.

videos.title: A Sparkling Moment
videos.overview: After winning a game competition, Mal invites everyone on a glamping trip. As they laugh and play, Hyun feels awkward seeing everyone openly affectionate. He pulls An aside to kiss him…

videos.title: Behind the Stage, the Secrets Left Behind
videos.overview: After the survival program, one of them successfully debuted as an idol and is now actively promoting, while Su An remained a trainee. But the “Mallangs” video that became a hot topic back then continues to circulate, keeping speculation about their relationship alive. Now, after successfully wrapping up activities with the project group, Su An is preparing for debut as they each move forward on their own paths. Meanwhile, Jae Min gives up on his dream of entering the entertainment industry due to the controversy surrounding him during the survival show, and returns to school to focus on everyday life. (Source: Korean = Wavve )

videos.title: He Came into My Life
videos.overview: Khun appears in front of Jae Min, who has returned to school. From their very first meeting, Khun approaches Jae Min without hesitation and, with his unexpectedly straightforward charm, manages to get his phone number. The two naturally begin keeping in touch, and for the first time, a new relationship enters Jae Min's everyday life.

videos.title: It's Already Too Late
videos.overview: After the survival show, Hyeon Jae and Su An have completely cut ties. Having gone without any contact, the two meet again when Hyeon Jae seeks Su An out. But instead of happiness at seeing each other, what surfaces first is awkwardness. Unable to confirm how the other truly feels, their conversation keeps missing the mark, and the emotions they've been carrying remain unresolved. In the end, they part ways once again, stuck in an awkward limbo, unable to reconnect. (Source: Korean = Wavve || Translation = MyDramaList)

videos.title: The Reason They Lost Contact
videos.overview: After Hyeon Jae's debut, the real reason the two of them lost contact is finally revealed. Back then, Hyeon Jae's company tightly controlled him, restricting both his phone access and outside communication. As a result, Su An's messages never reached him, and their relationship was cut off. Unaware of the truth, Su An keeps Hyeon Jae at arm's length, treating him coldly as if pushing him away. Meanwhile, Jae Min wakes up at Khun's house and spends an awkward morning recalling what happened the night before. The events that unfolded under the influence of alcohol bring the two of them even closer. (Source: Korean = Wavve || Translation = MyDramaList)

videos.title: Became One Team
videos.overview: The merger project between P&JS and Unicorn officially begins. Among the trainees, Hyeon Jae remains a well-known and highly noticed figure, while Jae Min receives mixed reactions due to a past controversy. Meanwhile, Hyeon Jae crosses paths with Su An again in the practice room, but Su An brushes past him as if nothing had happened. (Source: Korean = Wavve || Translation = MyDramaList)

videos.title: Ran Away, to Korea
videos.overview: Khun's past is finally revealed. Back when he was active as a star in Thailand, his everyday life fell apart under the relentless attention of obsessive fans and constant surveillance. The reason he came to Korea in an attempt to escape that situation comes to light. At the same time, Khun begins to show suspicion toward Jae Min and starts keeping his distance from him. Caught off guard, Jae Min is left trying to process and accept those feelings. (Source: Korean = Wavve || Translation = MyDramaList)

videos.title: Past and Present Collide
videos.overview: Hyunjae takes a drunken Sooan home, and for a brief moment, they both let down their guard. Meanwhile, Jaemin stands up for Khun, making Khun feel even more drawn to him.

videos.title: Broken Teamwork
videos.overview: Jaemin keeps struggling to follow the rhythm, but Khun helps him break through the challenge. Meanwhile, Sooan discovers that Hyunjae has been secretly taking care of him, and sweet sparks begin to quietly ignite between them.

videos.title: Relationships become content
videos.overview: The trainees' dance video unexpectedly goes viral, and fans are eagerly hoping to see Hyunjae and Sooan reunite once again as the beloved "Malluongz CP."

videos.title: Two People Who Crosses the Line
